messages.author: 3da48b33a2f506a9
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] My Shinyapp isn't loading assuming that the process is killed due to app_idle time out ?
parts:
It is very possible that your app is running out of memory during initialization. You could try deploying your app with large memory size:

shinyapps::configureApp("app_name",account="account_name",size="large",redeploy=TRUE)

and see if that makes a difference.


Fereshteh
